title: A Reality Check of Language Models as Formalizers on Constraint Satisfaction Problems
abstract: arXiv:2505.13252v5 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Recent work shows superior performance when using large language models (LLMs) as formalizers instead of as end-to-end solvers for symbolic reasoning problems. Given the problem description, the LLM generates a formal program that derives a solution via an external solver. We systematically investigate the formalization capability of LLMs on real-life constraint satisfaction problems on 4 benchmarks, 6 LLMs, and 2 types of formal languages. We show that LLM-as-formalizer by no means trivializes the problem but underperforms LLM-as-solver in 15 out of 24 model-dataset combinations, despite the former's verifiability and interpretability. Although the formalization space is magnitudes smaller than the search space, our scaling analysis shows that LLM-as-formalizer still drastically degrades as problem complexity increases similar to LLM-as-solver. To better understand this limitation, we observe excessive, solver-like reasoning tokens

translated_title: 对语言模型在约束满足问题上作为形式化工具的现状检验
translated_abstract: arXiv:2505.13252v5 公告类型：替换 摘要：近期研究表明，在符号推理问题中，使用大型语言模型（LLMs）作为形式化工具而非端到端求解器时表现出更优性能。给定问题描述，LLM生成一个形式化程序，通过外部求解器推导出解决方案。我们系统地调查了LLMs在4个基准、6种LLM和2种形式语言类型上对现实约束满足问题的形式化能力。我们显示，LLM作为形式化工具绝非简化问题，在24个模型-数据集组合中，有15个组合其性能不如LLM作为求解器，尽管前者具有可验证性和可解释性。虽然形式化空间比搜索空间小几个数量级，但我们的规模分析表明，随着问题复杂性增加，LLM作为形式化工具的性能仍大幅下降，类似于LLM作为求解器。为了更好地理解这一局限性，我们观察到过度的、类似求解器的推理标记。
tldr: 本文系统评估了LLM作为形式化工具在约束满足问题中的表现，发现其在多数情况下不如直接作为求解器，且性能随问题复杂度增加而显著下降。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically evaluates LLMs as formalizers on constraint satisfaction problems, finding they underperform LLM-as-solver in most cases and degrade significantly with increasing problem complexity.
